description: Image comparisons applied by qualify.py in addition to the upstream TolerantImageComparer assertions, which stay unchanged. Metrics use RGB channels in 0-255 units. The DirectX bounds come from the original Windows WARP output and the upstream reference image only, never from a translated output: by the triangle inequality, a translated image that is no less accurate than WARP relative to the reference satisfies meanAbsoluteError(target, WARP) <= 2 * meanAbsoluteError(WARP, reference) and largePixelFraction(target, WARP, 2t) <= 2 * largePixelFraction(WARP, reference, t). The margins allow for float-to-unorm rounding and isolated edge pixels.

shaderImages.description: Every ShadersTests case reads back one RGBA8 texture whose pixels the runtime captures by content hash. Upstream saves it as Shaders/<shader>.png and compares it with Assets/<shader>.png using the threshold of the test method.

processingImages.description: ImageProcessingTests save the GPU result and the ImageSharp CPU reference as JPEG files. The DirectX bound comes from the WARP GPU output and the CPU reference of the Windows run.
